description: This file defines the main custom element <openclaw-app> for the OpenClaw UI application. It manages state, lifecycle, event handling, and interactions for a complex web app built with lit-element/lit. It imports numerous internal modules and external types, and contains methods for controlling app behavior, connecting to gateways, handling chat and settings, and rendering the application UI.

classes.name: OpenClawApp
classes.description: The main web component class for the OpenClaw UI, managing state, lifecycle, event handling, and rendering logic for the app.

methods.description: Initiates connection to the backend gateway via internal handler.
